limitations: Current client geometry/frame provenance is 37.0.0.255130.254477; game values are separately pinned to historical build 5834.

Generic frame/portrait shaders remain compatibility approximations. The gem DiffuseAlphaMaskScroller is translated from same-build Metal: original opaque alpha-mask semantics, scroll/tint/fade and lighting equation; built-in lighting globals replace URP globals.

UberText is replaced with dynamic TextMesh at original anchors and exact serialized Latin fonts; Chinese uses original BlizzardGlobal fallback. Locale substitution, curvature and render-to-texture behavior are not exact parity.
Normals, available UV/color/tangent/skin channels, triangle winding, material slot order and every hierarchy transform are preserved. Top root translation is reset at instantiation only.
Source extraction currently has no tangent or skin channels for selected MeshRenderer geometry. Missing channels are not fabricated.

Original enabled hero and power static shadow geometry/materials are rendered using source-verified blend/formulas. Projected/contact shadows have no resolved runtime material binding and are not synthesized.

Readiness uses original planes, source green materials, static masks and the selected Highlight shader translation. Dynamic minion silhouettes are disabled because exact Grey/White pass shaders remain unresolved; the _ShaderTime clock uses local seconds and is qualified; no painted glow image is created.
Private noncommercial study. Original game art remains copyright Blizzard Entertainment; public availability does not grant redistribution rights.
